name: Compagnie Financiere de Neufcour S.A.
summary: Compagnie Financière de Neufcour S.A. engages in owning and managing commercial and residential real estate properties. The company sells land and houses, as well as rents offices and halls. Compagnie Financière de Neufcour S.A. was founded in 1995 and is based in Fléron, Belgium.
